resources.string: Taskarian is an agentic browser built as a fork of Mozilla Firefox.* Copyright and license notices are provided below.
* Taskarian is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mozilla.
Passwords saved in %s are encrypted and stored on this device.
Automatic cookie-banner handling is not available for this site. You can choose the cookie options on the page.
Blocks tracking cookies and scripts according to the protection mode you choose.
Blocks additional trackers. Some sites may not work properly.
Removes browsing history from this device.
History, cookies and site data are cleared when all private tabs are closed. Bookmarks and downloaded files remain.
